title: 2026 Election Analysis
text: This brief analysis summarizes a small sample of 2026 election results across a set of states. The goal is to compare vote totals by party and state, and to see which states are the closest contests.

title: 2026 Election Analysis
text:
Closest races
The closest races are the ones with the smallest margins between the Democratic and Republican candidates.


# A tibble: 8 × 3
  state         margin winner    
  <chr>          <dbl> <chr>     
1 Arizona        40000 Republican
2 Georgia       110000 Republican
3 Pennsylvania  160000 Democratic
4 Florida       560000 Republican
5 Illinois      570000 Democratic
6 Texas         800000 Republican
7 California   1420000 Democratic
8 New York     1480000 Democratic


In this sample, the tightest contest is the one with the smallest margin between major-party candidates. These close contests are often the most informative for understanding turnout and vote-share patterns heading into election night.
